title: Recorded model-run evidence for a prompt-kind eval case
_comment: R6: `kind: prompt` cases are NEVER executed in CI (your decision, R4: model runs are deliberate, recorded as dated evidence; CI checks the RECORD). One file per case under benchmarks/results/evals/<skill>/<case>.json, written ONLY by tools/eval_evidence.py --record. prompt_sha256 pins the exact prompt text the run answered — editing a case ORPHANS its evidence (stale evidence is a check failure, not a silent pass). protocol `full` = the benchmark's own bar (>=3 runs; second judge on a >=20% repo-wide sample of full-protocol cases); `single` = one recorded run, the documented long-tail bar, upgradeable to full without schema change.

arm.description: who/what produced the outputs, e.g. claude-session, claude-plugin-desktop, teacher-device

model.description: the model id the run was served by, as reported by the runtime — never guessed

machine.description: auto-filled by --record: each machine sub-check's verdict; never hand-typed

by.description: model:<id>, human:<name>, or machine:eval_evidence (allowed ONLY when the case has a structured assert block and no prose assertions — deterministic grading needs no judgement)

quote.description: the output text the verdict rests on

overall.description: fail anywhere -> fail; CI goes RED on a recorded fail — a recorded failure is a finding, never wallpaper
